target: positive merchandise units (observed sales), calendar day

models.seasonal_naive: most recent observation-available value on the target weekday at or before the origin; fallback trailing mean
models.trailing_mean: mean of observation-available days in the 28 calendar days ending at the origin
models.gradient_boosting: sklearn HistGradientBoostingRegressor(loss=absolute_error), direct multi-horizon (horizon is a feature), pooled over aggregate + selected products, target and level features divided by an origin-time scale

test_product_panel: products are selected once at the first test origin and kept for the later weekly test origins (selection uses data <= the first test origin only)
product_selection: at each origin: stock codes sold on >= 50% of observation-available days in the 182 days ending at the origin, ranked by units in that window, top 5
availability_rule: target days with is_observation_available=false (no source records, quarantined rows, partial final day) are forecast but never scored; observed zero = available day without sales of that product
non_trading_rule: if a weekday had observation availability < 10% in history at the origin, all models forecast 0 for it (flag expected_non_trading)
interval_method: 80%: prediction + scale * empirical 10%/90% quantiles of (actual - prediction)/scale of the same model, pooled over earlier non-test origins with target date <= current origin, bucketed by scope (aggregate|product) and horizon (1-7|8-28); falls back to all horizons, then all scopes, if fewer than 25 residuals; lower bound clipped at 0. The latest (operational) forecast may also use test residuals.
tuning: gradient_boosting config chosen by the promotion metric on validation origins only
promotion_metric: mean of validation WAPE over {aggregate, products} x {7, 28}; lowest wins, ties go to the simpler model (seasonal_naive, trailing_mean, gradient_boosting)
metric_rules: horizon H window = forecasts with h <= H from origins whose full H-day window ends <= last complete day; WAPE = sum|error|/sum actual, null with reason when sum actual is 0
